title: Rhino: true-shape parts, proof before Revit, and families that look like their reference
note: Proposed 20 Oct 2026 at the owner's request: a PC without this file has no rules for Rhino work, so fmc_rhino refuses to pass parts and Gate A can't judge likeness. Rules marked Proposed run as checks once the owner approves; the limits are read by the server (rule 7: kit data comes from the kit).

proof.note: A part that goes into a Revit family as import_part must first pass fmc_rhino check and export_parts: the .3dm on disk is the one the check passed (same SHA-256), checked under this rulebook's version.

reference.note: Search the product by its name: a catalogue or datasheet gives dimensions, materials and several views; a standard gives the rules of use (seat height, clearances). A view may be a generated or traced image only when it says so (kind generated) and never counts as evidence.

likeness.note: Each reference view is compared with the same view of the model: Rhino first (the proof), Revit before release. The outline overlap (IoU) and the width/height ratio are measured by scripts/likeness/compare.py; a reviewer who did not build the family marks each signature feature present or missing. After max_rounds failed rounds the family goes to a person.

rules.title: Millimetres and one tolerance
rules.rule: Rhino part files are in millimetres with an absolute tolerance of 0.01 mm and an angle tolerance of 1 degree.
rules.check: fmc_rhino new_doc sets them; check reads them

rules.title: Closed, manifold, valid
rules.rule: Every part is one closed, manifold, valid solid (a Revit form is made only from a closed solid).

rules.title: No short edges
rules.rule: No edge is shorter than min_edge_mm (Revit drops curves under 0.78 mm); use a larger fillet or none.

rules.title: Smooth, not faceted
rules.rule: Curved parts are NURBS surfaces (revolve, loft, sweep, pipe, fillet), never polygon outlines or meshes standing in for curves.

rules.title: LOD 400 detail
rules.rule: At LOD 400 a part shows what is made: true section profiles and radii, real thickness, joints (tenons, welds, dowels where visible), fixings and hardware, and the parts the maker cuts as separate solids.

rules.title: Rhino for fixed shapes, Revit for what flexes
rules.rule: Anything a type or instance parameter changes is native Revit geometry on reference planes; Rhino parts are fixed true shapes, placed by parameters and varied by type.
rules.check: Gate A flex; import_part never on a flexing dimension

rules.title: Named parts carry their data
rules.rule: Each part's layer is its name; it carries a subcategory, a kit FMC_ material and a visibility (fine, medium_fine or all).

rules.title: Inside the envelope
rules.rule: No part is larger than the type's envelope, and no part sits more than envelope_error_mm outside the Coarse envelope.

rules.title: Weight budget
rules.rule: A LOD 400 family stays under family_mb_max; more than mesh_faces_warn render-mesh faces is a warning to simplify.
rules.check: fmc_rhino check; Gate A file size

rules.title: Rhino proof before Revit
rules.rule: A recipe with Rhino parts builds in Revit only when every part passed the Rhino check and was exported under this rulebook, unchanged since (same SHA-256).
rules.check: fmc_recipe check, build and batch refuse otherwise

rules.title: Complex shapes are proven in Rhino
rules.rule: A recipe marked rhino_required (a complex shape) has its curved parts as import_part from Rhino, not native stand-ins.

rules.title: Reference evidence
rules.rule: A family made from a picture has a reference file: at least min_views views, min_sources sources (catalogue, datasheet, listing, standard or maker), min_verified_dimensions verified dimensions, evidence for each material, and a list of at least min_features signature features.

rules.title: Generated views are not evidence
rules.rule: A view generated or traced by AI is marked kind generated; it may guide modelling but never counts toward min_views or as proof of size or material.

rules.title: Looks like the reference
rules.rule: Before release, every reference view matches the same model view (IoU at least min_iou, width/height ratio within max_aspect_diff) and a blind reviewer marks every signature feature present.

rules.title: Rhino likeness first
rules.rule: The likeness check runs on the Rhino renders before the Revit build, and again on the Revit family before release.
rules.check: likeness file from: rhino, then revit

rules.title: A person after the rounds
rules.rule: After max_rounds failed likeness rounds the family stops and goes to a person with the renders, the scores and what is missing.

rules.title: No brands
rules.rule: Generic library families carry no brand or model; a client-line family may carry the client's own.
